text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion and I are on our way back
from a day
out. At her insistence, we
stop by an Umamusume
store.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wow! There are plushies with our faces
on them!
And folders! And key chains!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Actually, I think I'm here less to
shop than
to study. ♪
choice_data_list: Was there something you wanted to buy?
Did you have something you wanted to buy?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wish to learn all about the concept of
"oshi"!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
F-F-F-FINE?! What is a beautiful, noble

Umamusume like you doing in a place
like this?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've come to study up on these
"oshis"
you always talk about so
cheerfully. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If you buy someone's merchandise, does
that
make them your oshi? Shall I buy
some of your
merchandise, Digital?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
GUH-HUH?! I could never hope to be
worthy
enough!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: B-besides! You've got the order backwards! First you decide on your oshi and then you buy her merch!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And you don't stop at simply buying
merch! You
must stan your oshi
twenty-four-seven! Material
purchases
are but one way to show your undying

love!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
When you buy merch, you're declaring
your deep
adoration for your oshi... In
short, the merch
heightens your
devotion!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! You really are the very best
person to
ask concerning all things
oshi. ♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please, Digital, tell me more, I implore
you! I have
so much to learn!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Waaah?! I'm not worthy! Th-th-th-the
mere
p-p-prospect of sp-speaking with
someone like
you on the topic of oshis
is—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: But I wish to learn from you! Please!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
M-my oshi's wish is my command! It's my
job as a
stan to do whatever I can for
you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I, the lowly Agnes Digital, will guide you
firsthand
down the path of the oshi as I
know it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now then, you two! Do you have a good
grip on
your light sticks?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hi, everyone! Thanks for coming out
today!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We're just getting started up here, so
don't take
your eyes off the stage!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Now, allow us to give you... a
performance as
dazzling as the view from
first place.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Right. Initiating street performance
protocol.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
HNGAAAH! SIMPLY SUBLIME! Can you
see it?!
They're not just bringing us
joy—THEY ARE
GIVING US LIFE!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I can, I can! They're all sparkling so
brightly!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: If you can see it, respond to it! Let your heart take control of your light stick and wave it proudly! That is what it means to stan!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whooooaaaa! Umapyoi! Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Umapyoi! Umapyoi! Do your best!
Umapyoooi! ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah.. ULTIMATE PLEASURE!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Absolutely! ♪ Your oshis are your
favorites—the
people you wish to cheer
on the most!
choice_data_list: Did you learn what having an oshi is all about, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! That's my Uma queen for
you! Your
majestic eyes really do
penetrate to the heart of
things!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
An oshi is the spring whose water
cleanses your
heart! The fountainhead
from which flows the
lifeforce of
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Witness their hard work and let yourself
be
moved! Embrace the energy their
radiant forms
emit! They'll give you the
means to overcome the
hardships of
daily life!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes! Oshis really are grand, aren't
they?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for those kind words! I sure
hope
you're right.
choice_data_list: Do you have an oshi, Fine?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But instead of "someone"... I wonder if
you'd do
me the honor of letting me be
your oshi, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I see! ♪
choice_data_list: I've been rooting for you ever since the day we met.
I've been rooting for you ever since we first met.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well then, as your oshi, I'll have to be
even cooler
from now on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Agnes Digital insists she
could never
impose upon such a
"precious pair," so Fine
Motion and I
head back by ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's see... Digital is cute. Shakur is
cool.
And Groove is lovely too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
But you know, there's someone who
gives me
even more energy than they
do. Someone who
works hard right by
my side.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Any ideas who that might be,
Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
HNNNGH OMG, a sneak attack right to
the
heart! I CAN'T!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Distracted helping Agnes Digital up
after her
sudden fall, I end up missing
out on learning the
identity of Fine
Motion's oshi.
